title: Force redraw auto-highlights in Structure Mode
description:
After placing new structure nodes, PSR auto-highlight lines do not rebuild on their own. Structure Mode now has a Force redraw auto-highlights button on the floating panel (and in the node-list right-click menu) that clears prior DB3 auto-highlights and rebuilds them from the current nodes + Plan Sync group.

Who is affected: PipeSync Plan View on pipeshare.live (BASE). SaaS unchanged until cPanel apply.

Hard-refresh Plan Sync, enter Structure Mode, click Force redraw auto-highlights after adding nodes.
changeLog: Add Force redraw auto-highlights button to Structure Mode floating panel.
Same action available in the structure node list right-click menu.
Rebuilds green PSR auto-highlights from current PDF structure nodes.
